audit_method: Three-source triangulation per family: family-pinned release headers (forward-decl evidence), wiki / project documentation pages (opacity phrasing where present), and ClangSharp Modern output (empty-struct emit). All three sources must agree before a name enters auto_detect_well_known; wiki evidence may be 'not_found' when sources 1 and 3 agree.
notes: Family-keyed roster for uniform Pattern B opaque handle postprocess. Core-owned handles are pulled into satellite postprocess runs as data so consumers rewrite Core pointers by value without reading Core generated files.

core.source: SDL2 release headers (vcpkg_installed/x64-windows-hybrid/include/SDL2/) + wiki.libsdl.org cross-validation + ClangSharp Modern output empty-struct verification

auto_detect_well_known.name: SDL_Window
auto_detect_well_known.wiki_evidence: The opaque type used to identify a window.

auto_detect_well_known.name: SDL_Texture
auto_detect_well_known.wiki_evidence: An efficient driver-specific representation of pixel data

auto_detect_well_known.name: SDL_AudioStream
auto_detect_well_known.wiki_evidence: An opaque structure that buffers, converts, resamples, and generally streams audio data.

auto_detect_well_known.name: SDL_Cursor
auto_detect_well_known.header_decl: typedef struct SDL_Cursor SDL_Cursor;   /**< Implementation dependent */

auto_detect_well_known.name: SDL_Thread
auto_detect_well_known.wiki_corroboration: SDL_CreateThread documents its return value as 'an opaque pointer to the new thread object' (https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL2/SDL_CreateThread).

auto_detect_well_known.name: SDL_sem
auto_detect_well_known.header_note: Struct tag is SDL_semaphore but the typedef (and ClangSharp emit name) is SDL_sem. Roster records the typedef name because that is what OpaqueHandleEmitRewriter matches on in the generated C# output.

auto_detect_well_known.name: SDL_hid_device
auto_detect_well_known.header_decl: typedef struct SDL_hid_device_ SDL_hid_device; /**< opaque hidapi structure */
auto_detect_well_known.header_note: Struct tag is SDL_hid_device_ (with trailing underscore) but the typedef (and ClangSharp emit name) is SDL_hid_device. Header comment explicitly states 'opaque hidapi structure'.
auto_detect_well_known.wiki_corroboration: Header comment on the typedef itself reads '/**< opaque hidapi structure */'.

force_opaque_exceptions.name: SDL_RWops
force_opaque_exceptions.reason: Header declares full struct body with function-pointer fields (size/seek/read/write/close) plus subclass state (FileRWops, MemoryRWops, custom user implementations). Field offsets are unsafe to expose because the actual layout depends on the runtime subclass. Constitution L293-302 mandates opaque emit.
force_opaque_exceptions.wiki_evidence: This is the read/write operation structure -- very basic.

force_opaque_exceptions.name: SDL_SysWMinfo
force_opaque_exceptions.reason: Platform-dependent union (X11, Wayland, Cocoa, Win32, KMSDRM, ...). The union layout varies by build platform via #if defined(SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER_*) and is unsafe to expose in a cross-platform binding because the active member depends on runtime platform, not on the .NET caller's compile-time selection. Constitution L293-302 mandates opaque emit.
force_opaque_exceptions.wiki_evidence: The custom window manager information structure.

force_opaque_exceptions.name: SDL_SysWMmsg
force_opaque_exceptions.reason: Platform-dependent union mirroring SDL_SysWMinfo (same #if defined(SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER_*) layout variance). Same opaque rationale: cross-platform binding cannot safely expose platform-conditional union members. Constitution L293-302 mandates opaque emit.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_BlitMap
excluded_candidates.reason: Field-scope only (SDL_Surface.map private field), no public API consumes or returns it. Header tags it as opaque + Private. SDL3 removed it entirely (replaced with `void* reserved`). Peer convention: SDL2-CS, Chroma-2D, flibit-SDL3 all use `IntPtr map` at the field. Per Constitution §"Opaque Handles" Implementation mechanism: field-scope-only opaques drop to nint via RSP --remap instead of Pattern B. See rsp/per-header/SDL_surface.rsp.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_iconv_t
excluded_candidates.reason: BCL-Replaceable Helper Exclusion Policy (Constitution §"BCL-Replaceable Helper Exclusion Policy"): SDL_iconv_open/close/iconv/iconv_string excluded because System.Text.Encoding provides BCL-idiomatic equivalent. SDL2-CS and Silk.NET both skip the entire family. No remaining function consumes SDL_iconv_t after the function exclusions; the empty struct emit becomes harmless residue. See rsp/per-header/SDL_stdinc.rsp.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_GLContext
excluded_candidates.reason: Pointer typedef (typedef void* SDL_GLContext). ClangSharp emits this as void*/nint, not as a struct type. Pattern B does not apply — it is already a by-value pointer at the C# level.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_MetalView
excluded_candidates.reason: Pointer typedef (typedef void* SDL_MetalView). ClangSharp emits this as void*/nint, not as a struct type. Pattern B does not apply.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_TimerID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for int. ClangSharp emits this as int. Not a handle.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_TLSID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for unsigned int. ClangSharp emits this as uint. Not a handle.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_threadID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for unsigned long. Handled separately by ClongDualDispatchRewriter for Win/POSIX width differences. Not an opaque struct handle.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_AudioDeviceID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for Uint32. ClangSharp emits this as uint. Not a handle.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_JoystickID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for Sint32. ClangSharp emits this as int. Not a handle (numeric instance identifier paired with the SDL_Joystick handle).

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_SensorID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for Sint32. ClangSharp emits this as int. Not a handle (numeric instance identifier paired with the SDL_Sensor handle).

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_TouchID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for Sint64. ClangSharp emits this as long. Not a handle.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_FingerID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for Sint64. ClangSharp emits this as long. Not a handle.

excluded_candidates.name: SDL_GestureID
excluded_candidates.reason: Value-type alias for Sint64. ClangSharp emits this as long. Not a handle.

image.source: SDL2_image release headers + ClangSharp Modern output verification; Image owns no local opaque handles at this audit date.

excluded_candidates.name: IMG_Animation
excluded_candidates.header_decl: typedef struct IMG_Animation { int w, h; int count; SDL_Surface **frames; int *delays; } IMG_Animation;
excluded_candidates.reason: SDL2_image-owned public full struct with exposed POD-like fields and explicit animation payload pointers. It is used by pointer in load/free APIs, but it is not an opaque forward declaration and has no platform-dependent union, function-pointer subclass state, or private-layout marker that would justify Pattern B force-opaque quarantine.
